title: Per-token latency & cost breakdown with explicit cache-hit attribution
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Add low-overhead, per-token timing and cost attribution hooks in the serving runtime to produce token-level metrics, structured logs, and traces that explicitly capture KV cache hit/miss impact. Output will feed the metrics/log pipeline (Prometheus + Loki/Fluent) and OpenTelemetry traces so Console dashboards can show: 1) per-token latency distribution, 2) incremental cost per token, 3) cache-hit vs cache-miss attribution, and 4) request-level breakdowns for tail latency debugging.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits a per-token timing span for every generated token with tags: model, seq_len, token_index, cache_hit(boolean).

Metric names: runtime.token_generation_duration_seconds_bucket, runtime.token_cache_hit{true|false}_count, runtime.kv_latency_seconds (all instrumented with model/version, region, customer_tier labels).

End-to-end pipeline: traces arrive in OTLP collector (via agent) and are visible in Jaeger/Grafana; metrics show up in Prometheus and are queryable for p50/p95/p99 per-token latency by model and sequence length bucket.
Observed runtime overhead at steady-state <= 1.5% p50 latency (measured on perf harness for gpt-like-7B at typical batch sizes).
Console dashboard: token-level waterfall view for single requests and aggregated heatmaps for cache impact across models. URLs to dashboards included in delivery notes.
tasks: Design: finalize the minimal span schema (trace/span names + tags) and metric dimensions; align with backend observability team.
Runtime: add lightweight token-span API (start_token_span, tag_token_span, end_token_span) with a compile-time no-op option for builds that disable instrumentation.
Cache instrumentation: record KV lookup start/end and surface cache_hit boolean on token spans; emit kv_latency_seconds metric with cache_hit label.
Collector config: update OTEL collector config to reduce cardinality and enforce label cardinality guards; add sampling rules for high-volume customers.
Pipeline: map token spans to Grafana's waterfall panel and export aggregated Prometheus metrics for heatmaps; add Loki JSON log schema for per-request aggregated tokens when debug enabled.
QA/Perf: run perf harness across representative models and batch sizes; validate overhead and false positives in cache attribution.
Rollout: behind feature flag (token_attribution_v2) with staged rollout to internal orgs, then customer beta, then GA.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: telemetry cardinality explosion due to unbounded prompt metadata. Mitigation: only include high-cardinality labels when feature_flag == debug and add label scrubber in collector.
Risk: instrumentation adds CPU overhead impacting latency. Mitigation: inline fast-path no-op and C++ hot-path with fallbacks; strict perf test gating (<1.5% p50 impact).

Risk: mis-attribution of KV cache time when async IO overlaps token generation. Mitigation: record KV timing ranges and compute attribution in post-processor; add conservative attribution mode (only attribute full KV time to tokens that triggered the miss).
implementation_notes: We will implement token spans at two granularities: minimal (start/end timestamps, token_index, cache_hit) emitted for every token; and debug (full per-layer timings and intermediate buffer sizes) emitted only when debug sampling is on. Use OTel lightweight SDK; avoid creating new high-cardinality tags by bucketing seq_len and token_index (e.g., seq_len_bucket: 1-64,65-256,257+). Metric naming follows existing conventions: runtime.*. Use histogram buckets aligned with current latency distribution (log-spaced).
performance_results: Perf harness (model: redwood-7B-qa, batch=8, seq=128): baseline p50=22ms, p95=58ms. With token spans enabled (minimal) p50=22.3ms (+1.4%), p95=58.9ms (+1.55%). Debug instrumentation (sampled 1%) shows p50=23.4ms (+6.4%) — acceptable for sampled traces only.

2025-02-18 - Arjun Rao (Eng): First prototype landed in runtime branch feature/token-spans. Verified minimal spans emitted and ingested by local OTEL collector. Observed 1.2% overhead at batch=1; need wider coverage.

2025-02-25 - Diego Alvarez (SRE): Collector config updated to drop unexpected labels. Added scrape limits for high-cardinality customers and a sampling rule for spans from /v1/generate endpoints with rate 0.01 by default.

2025-03-03 - Maya Chen (Eng Lead): Ran extended perf matrix across gpt-like-7B/13B and non-gpt decoder models. Minimal spans within budget; approved GA gating criteria. Preparing rollout plan and customer beta list.
2025-03-08 - Design review (Ruth Kim): UX feedback — add an aggregated cache-impact heatmap and single-request token waterfall with hover tooltips that show attribution and cost-per-token.
notes_for_release: Feature flag: token_attribution_v2. Beta: internal + selected customers (contact eng success). Default sampling for debug spans: 1%. Add console docs: how to interpret cache_hit label, and how to enable token-level traces. Monitor the metric runtime.token_generation_duration_seconds_bucket for unexpected spikes after rollout.
